findings: MediaIndexingStatusItem disables refresh/scan while loading or indexing. This narrows ordinary UI reentry, but does not provide ViewModel job serialization previously found absent.
Missing imported folders dialog calls createAndImportMissingFolders without a busy flag or disabling Create, allowing repeated UI submissions while asynchronous folder creation runs.
AccentColorDialog uses isSystemInDarkTheme rather than selected AppTheme for palette and hex preview; forced application light/dark settings can show a palette variant different from the applied one.
Organized-history reset button is visible only when rememberProcessedMedia is enabled, adding another UI condition to the previously reviewed permanent-only-history guard.
Settings search matches localized section/title and English keyword hints, not descriptions. UI uses an eager scrolling Column; no long-list performance benchmark was run.
Import accepts JSON and plain-text MIME types but both reach the same JSONArray parser. MIME selection is not format/schema validation.

Scope management truncates each path to its last 35 characters and removes entries without confirmation. Independent booleans allow scope management and folder-search dialogs to coexist; actual modal layout remains unrendered.

Unindexed-files dialog distinguishes hidden-only files from no unindexed files and offers a hidden-file toggle. An ideal-state message is presentation policy, not evidence that every media format was discovered.
